digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow and plan review subsystems
propositions: gate_dispatch.py at 799 LOC with only 1 line of headroom is blocking story 343b's gap-5 parameter threading, which requires adding arguments to three finalize_verdict call sites within that file
nine modules (including three at exactly 800 LOC) are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC cap, creating a queue of blocked changes that cannot fit without splitting

the PLAN-REVIEW RECOVERY cluster (STEP_* constants, GateContractError, _collect_step_ids, validation functions, recovery/metrics functions) forms an existing call-graph seam extractable to plan_review_recovery.py without test edits
the CONTEXT-ASSEMBLY cluster (assemble_context and related memoization functions) in orchestrator.py forms an existing call-graph seam extractable to context_assembly.py without test edits

the code-review gate cluster cannot be extracted in this ticket because code_review_enabled is monkeypatched by string across 14 sites, and moving it would silently break those patches unless reference semantics are changed (a design change, not a relocation)
